postconditionResults.evidence: The phase is guarded by an explicit anti-vacuity gate at :1917-1918 — `VACUOUS REHEARSAL: uniboost hook mintDebt is zero at pull time, so the conservation assertion below would prove NOTHING - do NOT relax this gate, fix the accrual` — which requires mintDebtBefore > 0 BEFORE pull().
